title: Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B using P = E²/R and E = Blv, obtaining B = √(PR)/(lv) = √30/5 T.

title: Force Expression (Non-Magnetic)
description: Important: For 0 ≤ x < 0.2 m, derives F = ma + mgsinθ + μmgcosθ, with a = k²x, resulting in F = 0.96 + 2.5x N.

title: Force Expression (Magnetic)
description: Important: For 0.2 m ≤ x ≤ 0.8 m, includes Ampere force F_A = (Bl)²v/R, giving F = 0.96 + 3.1x N.

title: Total Joule Heat
description: Essential: Correctly sums work done against Ampere force during upward (W_A1) and downward (W_A2) motion to find Q = 0.324 J.

title: Downward Motion Analysis
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem to find velocity re-entering magnetic field, considering gravity and friction.

title: Ampere Force Work (Upward)
description: Important: Calculates W_A1 as area under F_A vs. x curve (trapezoid) from x1 to x2.

title: Ampere Force Work (Downward)
description: Important: Calculates W_A2 using constant velocity (from energy) and F_A over magnetic region length.

title: Sign/Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign of friction or Ampere force in Newton's second law or work-energy equations.

title: Region Confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect force expression (e.g., omits Ampere force) for a given displacement range.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and final answers.
